title: Europe got its own TBPN-style live show, and everyone’s angling for a guest spot
summary: The five-day format will look quite similar to the two-day format. There will be a live show from 12 p.m. U.K. time to 3 p.m., breaking down trending stories, and then for two hours, they will have guests on the show talking about whatever they want.
